title: Asking your manager for more time
context: Your project report is due Friday, but your teammate Sam is out sick and you won't finish in time. You could have it done by Tuesday.

messages.text: Hey, just checking in. Is the report still on track for Friday?

options.text: Sam is out sick, so we're behind. Could we move the deadline to Tuesday? I'll send what's done by Friday.
options.reaction: Thanks for the heads-up. Tuesday works.

options.text: Sam being out has wrecked everything. It's not my fault it's late.
options.reaction: Let's talk about how to fix this rather than whose fault it is.

options.text: Can we talk later? Kind of busy right now.
options.reaction: Okay, but I need an answer today.
